scope: Explicit local CLI import of exactly one configured account/day followed by an independent read-only verification; no collection, HTTP write, schema creation, migration, deletion or automatic rollback
authorization: An explicit invocation is required. SOURCE_READY alone never executes or authorizes a write. This development unit exercises writes only in an isolated synthetic local schema, not the existing historical fact schema.
preconditions: All paths resolve inside this workspace's .local; the supplied receipt bytes match the supplied SHA256 and the selected date.
Every source and config evidence item still matches its recorded path, size and SHA256. Reprepare and validate the selected input without opening unrelated source dates.

Credentials are read only for execution, never printed or included in receipts. Loopback MySQL only; server datadir must resolve inside this workspace's .local; existing project tables and Flyway version/checksum must match. No CREATE or migration in the repair runner.
The selected account/day current hash must equal expected-current-hash-or-MISSING under the same transaction lock as import. A stale expectation rejects without publishing or adding fact versions.
Only the selected account/day can reach the existing versioned transactional store. Preserve canonical content deduplication and the two-version/third-isolated rule.

statuses.CURRENT_VERIFIED: Transaction returned a current version and a separate read-only connection independently matched source identity, pointers, all rows and content hash; imported or idempotent is recorded separately.
statuses.STORED_NOT_CURRENT: A previous or isolated version was returned; not repaired/published success, even when idempotent.
statuses.COMMITTED_UNVERIFIED: A returned transaction result is recorded but independent current verification or final source recheck failed. Never claim rollback or success; maintenance investigation required.
statuses.REJECTED: A known precondition/transaction rejection; does not imply every possible database failure is proven rolled back.
statuses.EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN: Transaction completion could not be established. Never automatically retry, claim rollback, or show success.

rules: Unavailable counts, identifiers and outcomes are null, not 0 or success.
Only fixed error codes; no SQL errors, credentials, raw facts or account IDs in console/receipt.
Private receipt retains exact target schema/port and source/config/preflight evidence, not credentials. An interrupted RUNNING receipt is not success.
Before-state expectation and previous version are retained for a separately reviewed rollback. No automatic deletion or pointer rollback in this unit.

operationsFeedback: After CURRENT_VERIFIED, explicitly refresh the existing read-only operations day query and compare date/current content hash. The page displays live current state, not an inferred historical job result. No new unauthenticated write endpoint.
acceptance: Isolated real MySQL: missing single day -> CURRENT_VERIFIED -> operations AVAILABLE/EMPTY with exact hash and count; other day/account data untouched.
Repeat same input is idempotent; second content retains prior; third is isolated and never green repair success; old previous content is not automatically promoted.
Stale preflight/source/config and stale current expectation refuse execution; malformed arguments and unknown dates cannot broaden to all dates.
Independent readback failure remains COMMITTED_UNVERIFIED; uncertain transaction outcome cannot be reported as rollback.
Existing real facts/source files remain unchanged; frontend/backend regression and local preview checks pass.

ownership.local_source_preflight: LocalFactRepairMain, focused repair unit tests, minimal package-private reuse hooks in LocalFactPreflightMain/LocalFactVerifyMain/LocalFactImportMain; do not modify existing importer semantics
ownership.current_fact_reader: New isolated MySQL repair integration test and independent code review; no production source edits without coordination
ownership.dashboard_ui_binding: Minimal frontend maintenance instructions and tests only; no API contract expansion or layout change
ownership.main: Contract, integration orchestration, verification scripts if needed, docs and QA
